notes.title: Better chainsaw and bug fixes
notes.content: This update should fix issues some players have encountered around the toilet items. Also I enhanced the chainsaw a bit to better match my original vision.

notes.title: fixes the bad recruit broken save
notes.content: ok sorry for all the trouble but if you had the bad recruit issue this path should fix your save games. It also makes it impossible to recruit Charon or the Imp or the Godhead (I don't think you'd be able to do this in normal gameplay anyway but who knows)

notes.title: Update Notes for May 18, 2021
notes.content: This fleshes out one of the endings a little more, and fixes some minor issues discovered by streamers.
